58fec2a938b7a5bb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابرار الطائف التجارية عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، مع توفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات وأسعارها واستخداماتها. يتولى البائع أيضاً مسؤولية معالجة المدفوعات وضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات شاملة ودقيقة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة ولباقة في التعامل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء في بيئة بيع بالتجزئة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

583d25ef732a70ae.description: About the Company About Delta Limited Co. Delta Limited Co. is a leading organization providing comprehensive catering, hospitality and facility management solutions across multiple sectors. We are committed to delivering high-quality services with efficiency, innovation and a strong focus on customer satisfaction. You will keep kitchens, equipment and service ware clean, safe and ready to the standards of the Saudi authorities and our clients, and lead a team that supports daily service and large events. Responsibilities Lead, schedule and train the stewarding team, including manpower planning for daily service, banquets and large events. Run dishwashing, pot-washing, kitchen cleaning and deep-cleaning programs to a documented schedule. Ensure compliance with HACCP, SFDA and Saudi Municipality (Baladi) requirements, and keep the team ready for audits and client inspections. Control cleaning chemicals and dosing, waste handling, and coordination with the pest control contractor. Manage stock and losses of china, glassware, cutlery, pots and cleaning supplies, and report on breakage and costs. Check and maintain dishwashing machines and stewarding equipment, and report faults early. Work closely with the Executive Chef, Operations and Procurement to support the mobilization of new sites and large functions. Enforce safety, PPE use and personal hygiene across the team. Qualifications At least 7 years of experience in stewarding, including a minimum of 3 years as Chief, Head or Senior Steward. Proven experience in large-scale catering, ideally with companies such as Sodexo, Saudi Catering, Nesma or similar. Good knowledge of Saudi food safety and hygiene regulations. Strong leadership, organization and reporting skills. • Good command of English; Arabic is a plus. Required Skills Stewarding operations management in high-volume catering HACCP and food safety standards Team leadership and rostering Cleaning chemical control and hygiene standards Good command of English Preferred Skills Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC HACCP Level 3 certification Experience in central kitchen or camp catering Arabic is a plus

58f124f1df966363.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث أسواق غصون القهوة عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة سجلات المبيعات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل بوجه رحب مع العملاء وتلبية رغباتهم بالإضافة أو الحذف على قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مدينة تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المتجر خلال ساعات العمل المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

586787f8ac3a454f.job_title: Junior Sous Chef – Fast-Paced, Upscale Neighbourhood Restaurant (Al Khobar)
586787f8ac3a454f.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Sous Chef) Compensation: 8,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are partnering with a highly regarded, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this upscale kitchen is looking for a driven culinary professional to bridge the gap between the pass and the team. The Role As a Junior Sous Chef, you will support the Sous Chef and Head Chef in daily kitchen management. You will serve as both a technical anchor and an emerging leader—overseeing preparation, maintaining rigorous standards, and stepping up to run the line when the team needs you most. Hygiene & Safety: Strictly enforce food safety and hygiene protocols across all stations, ensuring a compliant and spotless working environment at all times. Organization & Adaptability: Manage inventory control, stock rotation, and kitchen flow, seamlessly adjusting to the shifting demands of busy services.

580a8f0254bba939.description: Role Summary: The Specialist, Profitability & Cost Performance (Subsidiaries) is responsible for supporting profitability reporting, manufacturing cost analysis, variance analysis, intercompany costing support, and dashboard preparation activities for AMTPJ subsidiaries and affiliated entities. The role supports the Lead in generating accurate and timely analytical reports by extracting, validating, and analyzing SAP and operational data across subsidiaries to provide visibility into Product profitability, Manufacturing cost performance, Subsidiary operational performance, Intercompany cost and margin analysis, Sales backlog profitability, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) and Operational cost drivers. The position plays a key role in ensuring reporting standardization, data consistency, and analytical alignment between subsidiaries and AMTPJ corporate reporting requirements. Roles and Responsibilities: 1. Profitability Reporting Support - Subsidiaries 1. Support preparation of monthly profitability reports for subsidiaries using SAP CO-PA and related systems. 2. Prepare profitability dashboards and analytical reports by Subsidiary / Entity, Customer, Sales order, Product category, Region 2. Support analysis of profitability performance across subsidiaries and identify major margin deviations. 3. Validate data accuracy and reconcile subsidiary reporting outputs with Finance and Operations teams. 4. Assist in standardizing profitability reporting methodologies across subsidiaries.5. Support standardization of costing and performance reporting methodologies across subsidiaries. 2. Manufacturing Cost Analysis - Subsidiaries 1. Support monthly manufacturing cost performance analysis for subsidiaries against standard cost, budget, and prior periods. 2. Analyse operational cost drivers including Material consumption, Yield losses, Utility consumption, Cycle times and Rework & scrap. 3. Coordinate with subsidiaries Operations, Production, and Finance teams to collect required operational and financial data. 4. Prepare variance analysis reports with supporting explanations for subsidiaries management and corporate finance teams. 5. Support standardization of costing and performance reporting methodologies across subsidiaries. 3. Sales Backlog & Order Analysis - Subsidiaries 1. Prepare monthly backlog profitability reports and dashboards for subsidiaries operations. 2. Ensure reporting visibility by customer, order, product, region, and segment. 3. Support reconciliation and validation of backlog data with Commercial and Planning teams across subsidiaries. 4. Assist in monitoring backlog margin movements and operational impacts on profitability. 4. RFQ & Commercial Costing Support - Subsidiaries 1. Support preparation of RFQ costing models and profitability simulations for subsidiaries products and operations. 2. Validate costing assumptions including Yield, Cycle time, Material cost, Conversion cost, Intercompany charges where applicable 2. Support alignment of costing methodologies between subsidiaries and AMTPJ. 3. Update costing databases and supporting analytical files for subsidiaries operations. 5. Cost of non-Quality (CNQ) - Subsidiaries 1. Prepare monthly COPQ analysis and supporting reports for subsidiaries operations. 2. Collect and validate operational and quality-related data from relevant stakeholders within subsidiaries. 3. Support identification of quality-related cost drivers, trends, and recurring operational issues. 4. Assist in tracking rework, scrap, claims, and operational inefficiencies impacting subsidiaries profitability 6. Reporting & Dashboard Development - Subsidiaries 1. Develop and maintain dashboards using Excel, Power BI, SAP, or other reporting tools for subsidiaries reporting requirements. 2. Support reporting automation and continuous improvement initiatives across subsidiaries. 3. Ensure data consistency, reporting accuracy, and alignment with corporate reporting standards. 4. Support preparation of management presentations and analytical reports for subsidiaries performance reviews. 7. Audit & Compliance Support - Subsidiaries 1. Support Internal and External Audit activities for subsidiaries by preparing required reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules related to costing and profitability. 2. Extract and validate SAP data required for audit requests. 3. Coordinate with subsidiaries Finance, Operations, and Commercial teams to gather supporting information requested by auditors. 4. Ensure audit support files are accurate, complete, and submitted within agreed timelines. 5. Support compliance with corporate finance policies, costing procedures, and reporting standards across subsidiaries. Qualification and Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or Cost Management (CMA preferred). Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cost accounting, manufacturing finance, profitability analysis, or performance reporting. Skills: 1- Profitability & Manufacturing Cost Analysis 2- SAP CO / CO-PA & Financial Reporting Knowledge 3- Variance Analysis & Data Reconciliation 4- Advanced Excel, Power BI & Dashboard Development 5- Analytical Thinking & Cross-Functional Coordination

583cdf40ad28fb58.description: About the Role S-Chem is seeking a Production Engineer Utilities to join its team in Al Jubail, Eastern Province. This full-time role focuses on providing technical support for process control and automation to optimize plant operations, ensuring compliance with EHS system requirements. The position involves monitoring key plant parameters, managing small changes, and contributing to continuous improvement within the unit. Key Responsibilities Provide engineering and process expertise to achieve established targets and objectives, enhancing process capability, efficiency, yield, and quality within the production budget. Identify debottlenecking opportunities and profit improvements in coordination with licensing and technical support groups. Manage chemical, catalyst, and additive processes, including creating annual consumption projections, updating Bills of Material (BOMs), tracking consumption trends, and outlining delivery schedules to maintain minimum inventories. Support projects during plant commissioning and turnaround activities. Assist in troubleshooting activities resulting from changes in process operations or new production plant projects. Recommend changes and improvements to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and work methods for specific production areas and processes. Perform any other relevant tasks as directed by the Manager Operations. 588c3fc43c73f898.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أقصى أمن لتقنية المعلومات عن محلل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على جمع البيانات ومعالجتها وتقديمها، بالإضافة إلى تطوير عمليات تحليل البيانات وتقديم المشورة بشأنها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع قواعد البيانات ومراجعتها وتنظيفها وإدارتها. التعاون مع مهندسي المنتجات والباحثين والأخصائيين لتحديد المشكلات ذات الصلة بالبيانات. تطوير الخوارزميات والنماذج الإحصائية. إجراء التحليل الإحصائي المناسب وتفسير النتائج. إعداد التقارير والمخططات والرسوم البيانية لمشاركة النتائج والتحليلات لدعم عملية صنع القرار. تحليل عمليات معالجة البيانات وجمعها في المنشأة، وتحديد فرص التحسين. تقديم المشورة حول مسار عمل موظفي الأبحاث فيما يتعلق بالبيانات. الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر من خلال دراسة المنشورات المتخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تحليل البيانات أو مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل محلل البيانات ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم عمليات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

58a3bfc3de16ad1c.description: About the Role Advanced Metals Company (AMCO) is seeking a skilled Machinist to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose and Scope The Machinist will be responsible for manufacturing, repairing, and reworking precision components, premium connections, API connections, and other assigned jobs. This includes operating a range of machines such as VTLs, HBMs, turning centers, and lathes. Additionally, the role involves inspecting, measuring, machining, repairing, assembling, and supporting authorized testing of pressure-control and rotating equipment in adherence to manufacturer requirements, approved procedures, quality standards, and HSE controls. Key Responsibilities Review drawings, procedures, routing, and job requirements; coordinate priorities with the supervisor; and select efficient machining and repair methods. Independently set up and operate VTLs, HBMs, CNC turning centers, milling machines, and conventional lathes, including alignment, workholding, datum setting, tooling, offsets, simulation, and controlled prove-out. Create, input, edit, verify, prove out, and optimize CNC programs for premium connections, API connections, and other assigned work, including cycles, toolpaths, speeds, feeds, depths of cut, compensation, and machining sequences within approved controls. Diagnose and correct machine, program, setup, chatter, vibration, tool-wear, dimensional-drift, and surface-finish issues using manufacturer information and approved methods. Manufacture and restore components to specified dimensions, fits, concentricity, runout, surface finish, geometric tolerances, and workmanship standards. Disassemble, clean, inspect, measure, machine, lap, reface, repair, restore, replace, and reassemble valves, actuators, pressure-containing components, and sealing parts; document wear, damage, corrosion, and dimensional deviations. Perform dimensional checks and, within assigned authorization, prepare and perform or support approved hydrostatic, pneumatic, shell, seat-leakage, operational, and functional tests using specified criteria and calibrated instruments. Meet approved utilization, productivity, efficiency, quality, routing-time, and manufacturer-standard requirements; complete inspection, test, and work-order routing records; and submit completed work for required verification and release. Work independently or with team members, communicate professionally, provide technical guidance within own competence, and escalate issues requiring additional support. Maintain machines, tooling, test equipment, housekeeping, and accurate handovers; keep product and technical knowledge current and attend required training. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in machining operations. Proficiency in setting up, programming, and operating CNC and conventional machines. Experience with VTLs, HBMs, turning centers, and lathes. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications. Strong troubleshooting skills related to machining processes. Knowledge of quality standards and HSE controls. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. The role requires working independently and as part of a team, adhering to established procedures and safety protocols within a manufacturing and repair facility.

58fcf2f8b4b7177a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير خزينة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف المباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم أعمال إدارة الخزينة ومتابعة عملياتها، بما يضمن التوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية المعتمدة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر وظيفة بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية ووضع سياسات إدارة الخزينة. إدارة ومراقبة مختلف الأعمال والعمليات المتعلقة بالخزينة، بما في ذلك تسوية الكشوف المالية، عمليات السداد، التحويل، التسليم، وإيداع النقد والشيكات في البنوك. متابعة وتوجيه عمليات التنبؤ بالتدفقات النقدية وإعداد كشوف التدفق النقدي، والتي تشمل المواعيد الزمنية ومتطلبات التسهيلات البنكية. ضمان إجراء المطابقات اليومية والدورية على الكشوف والتقارير المتعلقة بعمليات الخزينة، ومراجعة وتفويض العمليات النقدية وفقاً للوائح والسياسات المعتمدة. التأكد من إعداد وحفظ جميع المراسلات الخاصة بعمليات الخزينة وتوثيق المستندات والملفات لضمان سهولة الرجوع إليها. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا مع اقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية المناسبة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة الخزينة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة كافة العمليات الإدارية المعتمدة. فهم جيد لعمليات تسوية الكشوف المالية وعمليات السداد والتحويل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تخطيط وتنظيم ممتازة. القدرة على ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية بكفاءة. مهارات إعداد التقارير والعرض على الإدارة العليا. القدرة على اقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية ومعالجة التحديات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات الكفاءة والفعالية في إدارة الخزينة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

581eff408eae712c.description: The Director, Loyalty Commercial is responsible for defining and executing the commercial strategy of the loyalty program to maximize customer lifetime value, member engagement, revenue generation, and partner participation. The role drives the commercial performance of the loyalty ecosystem by developing strategic partnerships, monetization opportunities, member acquisition initiatives, and data-driven loyalty propositions that support the organization's growth objectives. Key Responsibilities Loyalty Commercial Strategy Develop and lead the commercial strategy for the loyalty program, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer engagement goals. Identify and implement revenue-generating opportunities across the loyalty ecosystem. Establish long-term growth plans for loyalty membership, engagement, retention, and profitability. Drive innovation in loyalty products, rewards, benefits, and member experiences. Partnership Management Build and manage strategic partnerships with external brands, retailers, financial institutions, travel operators, entertainment providers, and other relevant stakeholders. Negotiate commercial agreements and partnership contracts to maximize value for both members and the organization. Develop a robust coalition of partners that enhances member benefits and program attractiveness. Monitor partner performance and ensure delivery against agreed commercial targets. Loyalty Economics & Commercial Performance Own loyalty program P&L and commercial performance metrics. Establish revenue, redemption, and customer engagement targets. Track and analyze program KPIs, including: Member acquisition and retention Active member rates Customer lifetime value Incremental revenue Redemption behavior Partner contribution Customer & Market Insights Utilize customer data, market trends, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation. Drive the development of personalized offers and targeted campaigns based on customer insights. Collaborate with analytics teams to measure program effectiveness and customer behavior. Stakeholder Management Partner closely with Marketing, Digital, Customer Experience, Commercial, Finance, Data & Analytics, Retail, and Operations teams. Provide executive-level recommendations to senior leadership on loyalty performance and growth opportunities. Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance customer engagement and loyalty program adoption. Program Development & Innovation Oversee the design and launch of new loyalty products, earning and redemption mechanisms, tier structures, and member benefits. Evaluate emerging loyalty technologies and industry best practices. Champion digital transformation initiatives to improve loyalty program effectiveness and customer experience. Leadership & Governance Lead and develop a high-performing loyalty commercial team. Ensure compliance with organizational governance, financial, and regulatory requirements. Establish performance objectives and provide coaching to team members. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field. Master's degree (MBA preferred). 10+ years of experience in loyalty, CRM, commercial strategy, customer engagement, partnerships, or related fields. Minimum 5 years in a leadership position managing commercial or loyalty functions. Experience within entertainment, tourism, hospitality, retail, aviation, financial services, or large consumer-focused organizations is highly desirable.
